credit_ledger_amount_sign.name: credit_ledger_amount_sign
credit_ledger_amount_sign.value:
("credit_ledger"."type" in ('GRANT', 'TOPUP') and "credit_ledger"."amount" > 0)
        or ("credit_ledger"."type" in ('DEBIT', 'EXPIRE', 'REFUND') and "credit_ledger"."amount" < 0)
        or "credit_ledger"."type" = 'ADJUSTMENT'

credit_ledger_debit_model.name: credit_ledger_debit_model
credit_ledger_debit_model.value: "credit_ledger"."type" <> 'DEBIT' or ("credit_ledger"."model_code" is not null and "credit_ledger"."unit_cost" is not null)

plan_entitlement_credits_by_type.name: plan_entitlement_credits_by_type
plan_entitlement_credits_by_type.value:
("plan_entitlement"."plan_type" = 'subscription' and "plan_entitlement"."credits_per_cycle" is not null and "plan_entitlement"."credits_per_cycle" >= 0)
        or ("plan_entitlement"."plan_type" = 'one_time' and "plan_entitlement"."credits_per_package" is not null and "plan_entitlement"."credits_per_package" > 0)
